svg.aria-label: Bohr shells for first twenty elements
svg.title: Bohr shells for first twenty elements
svg.desc: Mini Bohr-shell diagrams for hydrogen (Z=1) through calcium (Z=20) arranged in their periodic-table positions. Each tile shows a tiny red nucleus surrounded by concentric circular shells with small blue electron dots placed around them. Vertical alignment shows that elements in the same column have the same number of outermost electrons.
svg.text: Each tile is a tiny atom. Concentric circles are shells; dots are electrons. Same-column elements have the same outer shell.
